verdict.rationale: GitBook documents a dedicated Change requests feature, a way to review change requests with GitBook Agent, and an editor built to 'write, review, and publish' content, so a propose-then-review workflow is a first-party capability. The pack only gives page titles and short taglines, so the individual review steps the story names are not shown. Missing for 10: documented review comments, explicit approval or reviewer-requirement steps, an evidenced merge-to-publish step, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, teammates propose changes that go through review — comments, approvals, and a merge step — before they publish

citations.quote: Review change requests with GitBook Agent
makes it easy to write, review, and publish technical content
